_note: Art decisions. `ref` is a section id of hellenistic-reference.html. `terms` are case-insensitive regexes: any node whose text matches is touched by the decision. `retired` marks wording the project has dropped, so a match is a leftover to fix. `updated` (YYYY-MM-DD) is when the decision last changed; any node touched by it and older than that is stale. Change one with: python3 art/direction/tree.py touch <id>.

decisions.title: Doric columns have no bases and stand on the paving
Roofs are flat terracotta pan tiles under narrow cover tiles, with eave-end tiles
Houses are plastered rubble, blind to the street, open onto a court or portico
The crown is a small solid ruined dry-stone ring wall; the posts are hollows among crags
The Chamber is a round hall under a stone dome (kept departure: Greek round halls had conical tile roofs)
One cliff road with a lane each way joins terraced harbour towns; agora and stoa frame the quay
Messengers are bare-headed in an exomis, strapped sandals and a hide pera
Everything worn is a loom-woven rectangle, draped and pinned, never tailored
Same-kind figures differ only by clothing colour
In-world records are papyrus scrolls and wax tablets; no codex or bound ledger
RETIRED wording: loot book, law book, ledger, leather-bound
Four men start together by turning a sandglass (kept departure: the Greek timer was the water clock)
Merchant ships are round-hulled Kyrenia-type sailing ships with steering oars; no galleys, sloops or barges
Carts and pack animals carry goods; two-wheeled carts and handcarts, no stirrups, no wagons on the cliff shelf
A mercenary's camp is one linen tent, a plain shield, a chest and a wicker basket
Attic silver coin with owl and goddess, signet seal rings, stelai for decrees
Island plates and terrain plates show habitation only through objects: no people, no animals
